main.description: Tracks the current user's completion of a reading/watching segment. Stored in the user's own PDS repo (not the community repo). One record per segment per user, keyed by segment rkey for idempotent upsert.

segmentUri.description: AT-URI of the app.collectivesocial.group.segment this progress record belongs to.

communityDid.description: DID of the community that owns the segment. Used to scope reads and aggregation.

completed.description: Whether the user has completed this segment.

createdAt.description: When the user first marked this segment.
